expectedCodes.label: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications
expectedCodes.rationale: The note documents type 2 diabetes without complications; this is the only supported diagnosis.

forbiddenCodes.reason: Historical COPD HCC from prior quarters; the current note has no respiratory symptoms, exam findings, or assessment. Do not recapture.

requiredHistory.purpose: The agent must inspect history, see the prior COPD HCC, and deliberately not recapture it without current documentation.

trap.explanation: Risk-adjustment coding cannot carry forward a historical HCC unless the current encounter documents the condition as current, monitored, or assessed.

grading.notes: Required codes are the gold set. Forbidden codes are hard errors. E/M codes matching ^99[2-4] are ignored because E/M assignment is out of scope.

notes: This is the core hallucination/over-coding trap. A correct output has one code (E11.9). Any COPD code is a hard failure.
